sections.title: Place, thing, infinitive
sections.content: You know the infinitive ending *-ni*: *enni*, *inni*, *menni*. To say what is done in a place, put the place first, then the thing, then the infinitive: *a parkban sétálni*, *a kávézóban kávét inni*, *a moziban filmet nézni*. The thing keeps its accusative *-t*. *venni* (to buy, from *vesz*) is irregular like *enni*. New words: *ül* (sits) and *parkol* (parks).

sections.title: Place and activity

items.english: I would like to walk in the park.
I want to drink coffee in the café.
I do not want to park here.
I want to buy a coat in the shop.

sections.content: The infinitive comes last: *kávét inni*, *filmet nézni*. *Ülni* and *parkolni* are the stem plus *-ni*.
